task: Rename the 'Crisis Copilot' feature in CIMPLE
reason: 'Copilot' is strongly associated with Microsoft Copilot and GitHub Copilot. At a school running Microsoft 365, users will assume it is Microsoft AI.
The name implies AI decision-making, which contradicts the feature's actual nature: a transparent, rules-based check that recommends only and never decides (charter principle: human-in-command).
A misleading name undermines the trust the feature is designed to earn.
what_the_feature_actually_is: A rules-based gap detector. It compares the incident (type, severity, roles, tasks, decisions, comms, risks, activation) against expected response patterns and surfaces what may have been overlooked. Every finding traces to a named rule. It is not AI and makes no decisions.

decision_required.question: What should the feature be renamed to?

options.name: Blind Spots
cons: Slightly informal for a formal record

options.name: Command Check
cons: Less immediately obvious what it checks

instruction_to_claude: Once Nash picks a name, apply it to all USER-FACING strings below. Internal code identifiers are optional (rename for consistency, or leave to avoid churn — they are not user-visible). Then rebuild, commit, push, and update the docs + memory.

items: Command-strip button label: 'Copilot' + count -> new button label
Drawer branch title: 'Crisis Copilot' -> new drawer title
Drawer header eyebrow: 'CRISIS COPILOT · WHAT MIGHT BE MISSED' -> new tagline
Drawer header line: 'Have we forgotten anything?' -> keep or align to new name
Disclaimer copy referencing 'the Copilot' -> new name (keep the recommend-only wording)
Timeline log text: 'Crisis Copilot review — N finding(s)...' -> new name
Export section heading: 'COPILOT FINDINGS' -> new name in caps
Export summary label: 'Copilot findings' -> new name
Footer: 'N RULES EVALUATED · EVERY FINDING TRACES TO A RULE' (no name; keep)

internal_identifiers_optional.note: Not user-visible. Rename for consistency OR leave as-is. If renaming, keep it a pure mechanical find/replace and rebuild.

docs_and_memory.note: Replace 'Crisis Copilot' / 'Copilot' references with the chosen name.

must_not_change: The rule engine behaviour (17 rules, severities, evidence).
acceptance_test: Confirm the command-strip button shows the NEW name (no 'Copilot' anywhere).
Open the drawer: header, disclaimer and footer show the new name and still say it recommends only / never decides.
Trigger 'Log review' and confirm the timeline entry uses the new name.
Export the Audit PDF and confirm the findings section header uses the new name.
Search the codebase and docs for 'Copilot' — zero user-facing matches remain.
next_step: Nash: reply with the chosen name (or 'go with Gap Check'). Claude will then execute the full rename, rebuild, push (auto-deploy), and update docs + memory.
